signup.title: Sign-up Agreement
signup.html:
I confirm that:

  1. I am 18 years of age or older, and the date of birth I entered is true.
  2. I have read and agree to the SuiteFace Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including individual arbitration and the class-action waiver (I may opt out within 30 days).
  3. SuiteFace does not guarantee or promote any relationship, match or outcome. My membership is at will.
  4. SuiteFace does not run criminal background checks on members.
  5. Meeting strangers carries risk, and harm can happen. I accept that risk. I will meet in public places, tell someone where I am going, arrange my own transportation, never meet in a private place for a first date, and call 911 in an emergency.
  6. I have never been convicted of a violent or sexual crime and am not required to register as a sex offender.
  7. Everything I put on my profile is true, I created it myself, and I will keep only one account.

buyin.title: Buy-In and Membership Agreement
buyin.html:
1. I authorize SuiteFace Inc. to charge $21.00 today for my Buy-In, which includes my first 30 days.
  2. I authorize a recurring charge of $2.10 every month, starting 30 days from today, until I cancel. I can cancel anytime online in Settings.
  3. I can pause once every 210 days, for up to 21 days. A pause longer than 21 days ends my membership, and returning requires a new $21.00 Buy-In.
  4. Charges are non-refundable except where the law requires.
  5. Contact with other members requires an active paid membership.
  6. 12-Card Deck Guarantee: if I'm dealt fewer than 12 cards within 10 days, I may ask for my $21.00 back or choose to stay (Terms 4.1a).
  7. Launch offer (Oct 17–31, 2026): if I join with a launch seat, the $21.00 Buy-In is waived and I authorize $2.10 today and every month until I cancel; rejoining after my membership ends requires the $21.00 Buy-In (Terms 4.1b).
  8. First 1,000: if I choose the First 1,000 during the launch offer, I authorize the $21.00 Buy-In, which is non-refundable even under the 12-Card Deck Guarantee, and I receive a numbered First 1,000 badge (Terms 4.1c).

lobby.title: Joker Maker Lobby Entry Agreement
lobby.html:
1. This $210.00 buys one entry to the Joker Maker Lobby. It is an access fee only.
  2. It does not purchase, guarantee or influence any Joker, and it is non-refundable for any reason, including if I make no Joker or a Joker is challenged or removed.
  3. I may only make Jokers about SuiteFace members, from my own first-hand experience.
  4. Safety concerns belong in Report a safety concern, not the lobby.
  5. If a Joker I make is found false or unjustified, by SuiteFace's records or by its staff's review, it backfires on me: I become a Joker for 45 days, and I can't challenge, appeal, buy out, clear, pause or hide it, be dealt new hands, or make Jokers until it ends (Terms 6.5b).
  6. No refunds, ever, of my lobby entry, membership or any other purchase because of a Backfire, except where a law that can't be waived requires one.
  7. SuiteFace's staff, contractors and authorized affiliates decide Jokers, challenges and Backfires in their sole, absolute and subjective discretion, and their decision is final. To the fullest extent the law allows, I waive any claim over those decisions in any court or forum in the United States, and any dispute I still have goes only to individual arbitration (Terms 6.10 and 9).

release.title: Release, Waiver and Hold Harmless Agreement
release.html:
In exchange for being allowed to use SuiteFace, I agree that:

  1. I understand the risks. Meeting people I don't know, online or in person, can lead to emotional harm, financial loss, theft, physical injury, sexual assault or worse. I voluntarily assume all of these risks, known and unknown.
  2. I am responsible for my own safety and choices, including whether, when, where and how I meet anyone, and what I share. In an emergency I will call 911.
  3. I release SuiteFace Inc., its owners, officers, employees, contractors and agents from all claims, demands, losses and damages arising from my use of SuiteFace or from the conduct of any member or other person I meet through it, to the fullest extent the law allows.
  4. I will hold harmless, defend and indemnify SuiteFace Inc. against any claim, loss, cost or damages (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising from my conduct, my content, any Joker or statement I make, or my breach of the Terms or the law.
  5. I won't sue SuiteFace Inc. over another member's conduct, and any dispute I do have goes to individual arbitration as the Terms describe (unless I opt out within 30 days).
  6. This release doesn't cover anything the law in my state won't allow to be released, such as SuiteFace's own gross negligence or intentional misconduct where that protection applies. If any part can't be enforced, the rest still applies.
  7. I have read this release, I understand I am giving up legal rights, and I sign it voluntarily.

attest.title: Joker Attestation
attest.html:
About the member named in my Joker, I swear that:

  1. This Joker is true and comes from my own first-hand, direct experience with this member, not from rumor or anyone else's account.
  2. I did not create this member's profile or account, I did not help anyone create it, and I have no knowledge of a friend or any other person creating it in order to target this member.
  3. I discovered this member's card on SuiteFace on my own, while viewing my deck (my best hand) or while searching in the Joker Maker Lobby.
  4. I am not acting with, or on behalf of, anyone else, and this is not retaliation for a Joker or report made about me.
  5. The reasons I selected and my statement are accurate, and any evidence I upload is genuine and unaltered.
  6. I take full ownership of this Joker and its claims. I understand I may be legally responsible if it is false, and I agree to defend and repay SuiteFace Inc. for any claim that results.
  7. If any of this is untrue, SuiteFace may remove the Joker, close my account and keep any fees I paid.
  8. If this Joker is found false or unjustified, it backfires on me: I become a Joker for 45 days with no challenge, appeal, buyout, pause or refund, and the house's decision is final (Terms 6.5b and 6.10).

sponsor.title: Business Partner and ZIP Sponsor Agreement
sponsor.when: Before any House Partner or ZIP Sponsor checkout
sponsor.html:
This agreement is between SuiteFace Inc., a Florida corporation, and the business named at checkout ("you"). The person signing confirms they are 18 or older and authorized to bind that business.

  1. What you're buying. - House Partner: a one-time $210.00 Partner Buy-In, then $21.00 a month, plus $2.10 for each Comp redeemed by a SuiteFace pair, billed monthly. The Partner Buy-In covers 12 months of partnership. To continue after 12 months, a new $210.00 Partner Buy-In is due. - High Roller Sponsor: $2,100.00 a year for access, plus $210.00 a week, plus $21.00 for each offer accepted by a High Roller Room member, billed monthly. Offers show only to High Roller Room members. - ZIP Sponsor: $210.00 every 30 days per package of up to 7 ZIP codes, renewing automatically every 30 days from your payment date until you cancel.
  2. One sponsor per ZIP. Each ZIP code has one live sponsor at a time. If a ZIP you want is taken, you may join its On Deck line, which holds up to 3 businesses in the order they joined.
  3. On Deck automatic payment. By joining On Deck, you save a card and authorize SuiteFace to charge it $210.00 (per package) automatically when one of your ZIP codes opens, for example because the current sponsor cancels, doesn't renew, or its payment fails after Stripe's retries. Your sign goes live once you're charged and your sign is approved, and your 30-day cycle starts on the charge date. You can leave On Deck anytime before you're charged by emailing help@suiteface.com.
  4. Your sign and offer. You supply your business name, headline, tagline, offer and website. SuiteFace approves every sign before it goes live and may decline or remove content that is false, misleading, unlawful, adult, hateful, or unsafe for a dating audience. Every paid placement is labeled Sponsored. Your offer must be real, honored as stated, and lawful where you operate.
  5. Leads. People who tap your sign may choose to send you their name, email and an optional phone number and message. They do so only after checking a consent box. You may use those details only to respond to that person's request. You won't sell or share them, add them to marketing lists without their separate consent, or contact them by text or autodialed call without the consent the law requires. You'll honor every opt-out and follow all privacy, email (CAN-SPAM) and telemarketing (TCPA) laws.
  6. Comps. A Comp is your offer to SuiteFace pairs who check in at your venue. You set its terms and fine print and you honor it. SuiteFace counts a redemption when a pair checked in through Play Hand reveals your Comp code.
  7. No guarantees. SuiteFace doesn't promise any number of views, leads, redemptions or customers.
  8. Cancel anytime. Cancel online or by emailing help@suiteface.com. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you've paid for. Fees already paid are non-refundable except where the law requires otherwise.
  9. Missed payments. If a payment fails, Stripe retries. If it still fails, your placement ends, your ZIP codes pass to the next business On Deck, and any Comp stops showing.
  10. Your responsibilities. You're responsible for your offer, your venue, your staff, and your customers' experience. You'll defend and repay SuiteFace Inc. for claims arising from your offer, your content, or your use of leads.
  11. Liability. SuiteFace's total liability under this agreement is limited to the fees you paid in the 3 months before the claim.
  12. Changes and ending. SuiteFace may change prices with 30 days' notice. Either side may end this agreement at the end of a paid period. SuiteFace may end it right away for a breach.
  13. Law. Florida law applies, and disputes are handled under Section 9 of these Terms. Notices: help@suiteface.com.

highroller.title: High Roller Room Agreement
highroller.when: Before verifying for, or buying into, the High Roller Room
highroller.html:
1. I have the ✓ ID Seal and I'm applying to join the High Roller Room.
  2. If I verify: I authorize SuiteFace and its partner Stripe to read the balances of the accounts I link, once, or SuiteFace staff to review the statements I upload. Every account and statement is mine (or jointly mine), and everything I submit is genuine and unaltered.
  3. I understand SuiteFace uses this only to check the $1,000,000 total, never shows my balance to anyone, erases the figures once decided, and deletes my statements after review. Verification lasts 12 months.
  4. If I buy in: I authorize a one-time charge of $5,000.00, which is non-refundable except where the law requires.
  5. False or altered information means removal from the Room and possibly SuiteFace, with no refund.
  6. I'll never ask another member for money or financial details, and I'll report anyone who asks me.

casino.title: Private Table Host Agreement
casino.html:
1. I'm building a Private Table on SuiteFace and I'll be its Host. I'm 18 or older and I've signed the Sign-up Agreement.
  2. I authorize a one-time charge of $21.00, which includes 12 seats and up to 7 ZIP codes, plus a one-time $2.10 for each additional seat (up to 52) and $2.10 for each additional ZIP code I add now or later, or, if I choose wider coverage, a one-time $210.00 per state or $2,100.00 for nationwide coverage.
  3. The Private Table's name and description are truthful. I won't present it as the official group of any school, chapter, church, business or other organization unless I'm authorized to, and I won't use anyone else's trademark or logo without permission.
  4. I understand SuiteFace reviews every Private Table before it opens and may rename, pause or close it. If it's rejected, I can rename and resubmit free or ask for a refund within 30 days. Otherwise these fees are non-refundable except where the law requires.
  5. I'll hold my games in public places, follow the House Rules and Safety Guide, never charge members to join through SuiteFace, and remove or report anyone who makes the group unsafe.
  6. Who may join (everyone, men or women), how many seats there are, and whether I approve requests are my choices, and I'll apply them fairly. I won't use the Private Table to sell, solicit money, recruit for schemes, or harass anyone.
